title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: Allows administrator access without valid credentials, exposing sensitive data and administrative functions.
remediation: Use prepared statements with bound parameters so login input cannot alter SQL queries.

title: SQL Injection Data Extraction
payload_used: ')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: Exposes user email addresses and password hashes through the product search endpoint.
remediation: Use parameterized search queries and validate input on the server.

title: Search Field XSS
impact: Executes injected JavaScript in the user's browser, potentially exposing sensitive information or enabling deceptive content.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and enforce a Content Security Policy.

title: Stored Feedback XSS
impact: Executes saved JavaScript when feedback is displayed, potentially allowing actions using the viewer's permissions.
remediation: Encode feedback when displaying it. If HTML is allowed, sanitize it with a maintained HTML sanitizer.
